svg.title: 28. Outward shoulder turn with a stick — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Bend both elbows to right angles and hold the stick across your waist. Place the towel between the stretching elbow and your ribs. Use the other arm to move that hand outwards while its elbow stays at your side.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.cuh.nhs.uk/patient-information/exercises-following-hydrodistension/
